question: Should CodexBar permanently expose persisted per-provider hexadecimal palette editing, or limit this change to automatic provider-branded defaults?
rationale: Both directions are technically viable, but the editor creates an ongoing settings, persistence, validation, and localization contract beyond the underlying visual enhancement.

options.title: Land branded defaults only
options.body: Retain descriptor-driven palettes and preview behavior while removing the persistent override editor and settings key.

options.title: Accept full customization
options.body: Keep the editor and stored overrides after complete fresh-bundle proof of the latest workflow is supplied.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep randomized confetti if curated provider branding is not worth the ongoing descriptor maintenance.

recommendation.title: Land branded defaults only
recommendation.body: Retain descriptor-driven palettes and preview behavior while removing the persistent override editor and settings key.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the original reset-confetti feature and are the clearest history-backed owner for deciding its product boundary.
